_comment: Curated coach lines. Retrieved at runtime, never generated.
This file is the reason the coach is safe to ship. Every line a frightened
person is told to say has been read and approved in advance by a human;
nothing unvetted is ever put in their mouth mid-call. An LLM may rank or
reword the *explanation* shown to the responder, but the `line` field is
Lines are indexed by stage and ordered within a stage by escalation, so
the coach can offer a firmer response if the first one does not land.

lines.line: Before we go further — which department, and can I call you back on the number listed on your website?
lines.why: A genuine caller loses nothing if you verify them. Someone impersonating an institution loses everything.

lines.line: I'll verify this myself. Give me your department and I'll call the number I look up.
lines.why: Never use a number the caller supplies. Looking it up yourself is the whole point of the check.
sources: rbi-advisories.md § Real case numbers are not read out over the phone as proof

lines.line: No agency handles a case over the phone. If this is real, send it in writing and I'll come to the station.
lines.tactic: Move to a channel that scammers cannot use
lines.why: Written process and in-person attendance are the two things a phone scammer cannot follow you into.
sources: rbi-advisories.md § No agency conducts a "digital arrest"

lines.line: If there's a warrant, it will still be there in an hour. I'm going to check this before I do anything else.
lines.why: Urgency is the tool. Naming it out loud and refusing the deadline removes the pressure the rest of the script depends on.

lines.line: Real legal notices arrive on paper. Post it to my address and I'll respond to it.
lines.why: Genuine proceedings are documented and slow. A consequence that is both catastrophic and immediate is manufactured.

lines.line: I don't keep things from my family. I'm putting you on speaker.
lines.why: Secrecy is load-bearing. Getting one more person into the room ends most of these calls immediately.

lines.line: There is no such thing as a digital arrest. I'm hanging up and calling 1930.
lines.why: Naming the tactic collapses it, and 1930 is the number that actually helps. Hanging up carries no legal consequence whatsoever.
sources: rbi-advisories.md § No agency conducts a "digital arrest"

lines.line: If you're really from my bank, you already have my details. I'm not reading anything out.
lines.why: Being asked for details the institution would already hold proves the caller does not hold them.
sources: rbi-advisories.md § Banks and the RBI never ask for OTP, PIN, CVV or passwords

lines.line: Nobody legitimate asks for an OTP. That request just told me what this call is.
lines.tactic: Treat the OTP request as the verdict
lines.why: There is no legitimate reason for any caller to want your OTP. It is the cleanest single-signal test available.
sources: rbi-advisories.md § Banks and the RBI never ask for OTP, PIN, CVV or passwords

lines.line: No agency asks anyone to transfer money to prove they're innocent. I'm not sending anything.
lines.tactic: Refuse the premise, not the amount
lines.why: Arguing about the amount concedes the framing. The framing itself is the fraud.
sources: rbi-advisories.md § Money is never seized by asking the owner to send it

lines.line: The RBI doesn't hold personal accounts. Whatever account you're describing isn't what you say it is.
lines.why: The supervised-account story only works on someone who does not know the RBI holds no retail accounts.
sources: rbi-advisories.md § The RBI holds no personal customer accounts

lines.line: Stop. Don't enter the PIN. Put the phone down and call 1930.
lines.why: At this point persuasion has already failed; only stopping the keystrokes matters. A payment delayed by a minute is usually a payment that never happens.
sources: upi-safety.md § Receiving money never requires a PIN

lines.line: You never need a PIN to receive money. If it's asking for your PIN, it's taking money out.
lines.why: Converts a judgement call into a check the person can make on their own screen, right now.
sources: upi-safety.md § Receiving money never requires a PIN

lines.line: No action needed — this call is behaving normally.
lines.why: Interrupting a legitimate call trains the user to ignore the system. Silence on benign calls is a feature.
